data.name: S_Behavior_UrlProtocol_D
data.value: Register verirandom:// and enable IPC for link activation and external integration

data.name: S_Behavior_LegacyUrlProtocol_D
data.value: Also registers upstream's secrandom:// scheme so existing secrandom:// links and integrations reach this app. A URL scheme has a single owner, so if upstream SecRandom is installed too, whichever registered last takes it and links may open the wrong program

data.name: C_LegacyUrlProtocol_Body
data.value: A URL scheme can have only one owner per user. Enabling this takes over secrandom:// for this app; if upstream SecRandom is installed as well, its secrandom:// links will be handled here instead, or the other way round, depending on which program registered last. Any resulting interface incompatibility, broken integration, or unexpected behaviour is your own responsibility and this software accepts no liability for it
